{{Current events|year=2019|month=10|day=31|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] confirms the [[Barisha raid|deaths]] of its leader [[Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi]] and its spokesman [[Abul-Hasan al-Muhajir]], and names [[Abu Ibrahim al-Hashimi al-Qurayshi]] as its new leader. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/isil-confirms-death-leader-al-baghdadi-names-chief-191031151709004.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A [[car bomb]] in [[Afrin, Syria|Afrin]] kills nine people and wounds over 14 others. No one has claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/car-bomb-turkish-held-part-syria-kills-least-8 (VOA News)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in Mozambique]]
**Seven [[Russians|Russian]] [[defense contractor]]s from the [[Wagner Group]] and 20 [[Mozambican soldier]]s are reportedly killed in attacks by [[Salafi]] [[jihadist]]s in northern [[Mozambique]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2019/10/31/7-kremlin-linked-mercenaries-killed-in-mozambique-in-october-sources-a67996 (Moscow Times)]
*A rocket is fired from the [[Gaza Strip]], exploding in an open field in southern Israel. The [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] retaliates by launching strikes against two [[Hamas]] military posts. [https://www.jewishpress.com/news/israel/idf/idf-attacks-hamas-military-posts-in-gaza/2019/10/31/ (Jewish Press)] [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-11/01/c_138519266.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Armed Forces]] of [[DR Congo]] (FARDC) began a new large scale offensive against the [[Allied Democratic Forces]] rebel group in the Congo's [[North Kivu]] province. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/dr-congo-launches-large-scale-operation-rebels-191101163242390.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Arts and culture
*An [[archaeologist]] discovers a {{convert|25|m|ft|abbr=on}}-wide [[ring cairn]] dating back to the [[Bronze Age]] near [[Tidenham]], [[Gloucestershire]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-gloucestershire-50208092 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[Ana Botín]], the chairwoman of Spain's [[Banco Santander|Santander]] bank, which has suffered a major stock price fall since reporting its disappointing third quarter earnings, buys €3.61 million worth of shares as a display of confidence. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-banco-santander-stocks-chairman/santander-chairman-buys-3-61-million-euros-of-bank-shares-as-price-falls-idUSKBN1XA2DT (Reuters)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Pakistan train fire]]
**A train catches fire in [[Liaquatpur Tehsil]], [[Rahim Yar Khan District]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. The blaze, apparently sparked by gas stoves used by passengers illegally cooking on board, kills at least 74 people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50245090 (BBC)]
*Firefighters in [[Hungary]] save 20,000 baby birds in the wake of a barn fire that broke out earlier this week. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/animals/make-way-for-ducklings-firefighters-save-20000-baby-birds/vi-AAJDtx9?ocid=spartanntp (MSN)]

;Law and crime 
*Police in [[Papua New Guinea]] withdraw the [[arrest warrant]] issued against former [[Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea|Prime Minister]] [[Peter O'Neill]], who was accused of [[corruption]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/402205/png-police-withdraw-former-pm-s-arrest-warrant (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[Mongolia]]n [[National Police Agency (Mongolia)|police]] arrest 800 [[China|Chinese]] citizens and confiscate hundreds of computers and [[SIM card]]s in [[Ulaanbaatar]]. Authorities believe they were part of a [[cybercrime]] ring involved in illegal [[gambling]], [[security hacker|hacking]] and [[identity theft]], among other activities. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mongolia-crime-china/mongolia-arrests-800-chinese-citizens-in-cybercrime-probe-idUSKBN1XA0NW?utm_source=reddit.com (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*Brazilian presidency
**[[Government of Brazil|Brazilian]] [[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|Congressman]] [[Eduardo Bolsonaro]] threatens to introduce a "new [[AI-5]]" in response to [[left-wing]] opposition to the government headed by his father, [[Jair Bolsonaro]]. [https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/eduardo-bolsonaro-se-esquerda-radicalizar-resposta-pode-ser-via-um-novo-ai-5-2-24053268?versao=amp (O Globo)]
*[[India]] formally splits [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]] into two [[States and union territories of India|union territories]], dubbed [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]] and [[Ladakh]]. Both entities will be directly governed from [[New Delhi]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-50233281 (BBC)]
*[[2019 Lebanese protests]]
**Days after [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Prime Minister]] [[Saad Hariri]] resigned, both [[France]] and [[Hezbollah]] call for quick formation of a new government, saying that reforms are needed to deal with [[Lebanon]]'s economic crisis. [[President of Lebanon|President]] [[Michel Aoun]] pledges that the new government will consist of [[Technocracy|technocrats]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-protests/lebanons-hezbollah-france-call-for-new-government-idUSKBN1XA19D?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-protests-aoun/lebanons-president-aoun-pledges-cabinet-of-technocrats-in-new-government-idUSKBN1XA2I6?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] votes 232 to 196 to approve a resolution formalizing the procedures of the impeachment inquiry into [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/31/politics/house-impeachment-inquiry-resolution-floor-vote/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Bolivian protests]], [[2019 Bolivian general election]]
**Two men are killed in a town in Santa Cruz, [[Bolivia]], during protests and riots over the disputed general election on 20 October.
**The [[Organization of American States]], with Spain, Mexico, and Paraguay as observers, begins its audit of the election results. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50248739 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*Researchers discover a shipwreck at a depth of {{convert|20,400|feet|m}} under the [[Philippine Sea]]. The shipwreck is believed to be the remains of the [[USS_Johnston_(DD-557)|USS Johnston]], a [[World War II]]-era destroyer. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/science/us-wwii-vessel-is-deepest-shipwreck-ever-found/vi-AAJE4Vn?ocid=spartanntp (MSN)]
